`ferry-coastline.json` contains the Hong Kong Lands Department's **SeaFill** polygons from the CSDI 1:50,000 topographic map, retrieved on 10 October 2026. Each polygon's first ring encloses water; subsequent rings exclude islands and other land. This is an independent geographic oracle, not hand-drawn route geometry.

© Government of Hong Kong SAR, Lands Department; source: CSDI Portal. The [CSDI terms](https://portal.csdi.gov.hk/csdi-webpage/doc/TNC) permit reproduction and distribution with government/source attribution. The exact download URL, metadata URL and attribution are embedded in the fixture. The Lands Department [iB50000 data dictionary](https://www.landsd.gov.hk/landsd_psi_data/SMO/data/iB50000_Data_Dictionary-GMLv.1.1.pdf), page 18 (III-4), identifies `HYDRPOLY / EWB / SEF` as WaterBody / SeaFill.

Extraction preserves all outer rings whose bounding boxes overlap `[113.97, 22.18, 114.24, 22.33]` and their overlapping inner rings. Coordinates are rounded to seven decimals (approximately 1 cm); no coast vertices are simplified, moved or invented. The fixture contains six of the source's twelve polygons and is used without network access. Tests verify known island/urban land and harbour water, then sample every ferry segment at intervals no greater than five metres. Each segment is also split at every source coastline intersection and every resulting interval's midpoint is checked, so narrow land crossings cannot fall between samples. A known Mui Wo pier sliver exercises that check. Only the first/last 35 metres of each route are exempt for pier decks.

`kmb-115-rank-shift.json` records the public KMB 115 outbound ETA snapshot generated at 15:18:02 Hong Kong time on 15 October 2026, with route stops from the bundled KMB network. Source: [KMB route ETA feed](https://data.etabus.gov.hk/v1/transport/kmb/route-eta/115/1), via the [Transport Department dataset](https://data.gov.hk/en-data/dataset/hk-td-tis_21-etakmb). Owner: KMB / LWB. Times are stored as epoch milliseconds and stop distances are cumulative straight-line metres for deterministic inference tests. Ranks shift at stops 3 and 13; the fixture tests matching and bounds, not ground-truth vehicle positions. Raw observation evidence is in the checkout-local `outputs/bus-review/` directory.
